title: WASD Cloth
summary: Cloth for 3D games: soft-body sheets with fabric presets, spring-bone chains for capes and skirts, wind zones, a flag shader, and a checker that measures cloth.
useWhen: A 3D game has cloth that moves: flags, banners, sails, curtains, capes, skirts, coat tails, hair, or cloth that the player pushes. Its sheets use SoftBody3D, which Jolt supports in Godot 4.7.
avoidWhen: 2D games, or cloth that never moves: drape it in Blender with wasd-cloth-blender.
